A complete video editor in your pocket: multitrack timeline, filters, effects, text, music and fast export. Everything works offline.
A full editor in your pocket
Drag to scrub, pinch with two fingers to zoom. Tap a clip to select it and drag its handles to trim. Long-press and drag to move or reorder.
With a clip selected the bottom bar shows its tools: split, speed, volume, transform, filters, adjustments, effects, mask, chroma and more. Double-tap a slider to reset it.
Tap the button between two clips to add a transition. Use the diamond next to a slider to animate any property over time.
Over 90 animated templates, 24 fonts, emoji, shapes and GIFs. Move, scale and rotate them with your fingers right on the preview.
Search free images, videos, GIFs, music and sound effects from several sources at once and add them to your project in one tap.
Export up to 4K in H.264, HEVC or AV1, as audio, GIF or a single frame. The export keeps running in the background. Your work is saved automatically.

Drag, pinch and rotate the element on the preview with your fingers. Dragging switches to relative position, which keeps its distance to the tracked point (the yellow mark).

Create an automatic edit from your photos and videos, with cuts on the beat of the music.
Pick your media and a style: the assistant builds a regular project with transitions, camera moves, color, title and music, and opens it in the editor so you can tweak it.
You can sort them before creating the edit. Long videos contribute their best section.
A style is picked at random or, if you use your own song, the one that best fits its tempo.
Searches Jamendo for instrumental music that fits the style and downloads it. Needs a connection. The music is Creative Commons: check its license if you plan to publish the video.
Keep the original sound of the videos
Natural uses all the media at the style\'s pace. With a fixed duration, shots get shorter or longer in whole beats.
The music could not be obtained, so the edit has none. You can add it from the editor.
No clear rhythm was detected in the music: cuts follow the style\'s tempo and may not match the beats.
The edit could not be created. Check the media and try again.
Long shots, soft fades and slow camera. Clean colors and relaxing music.
Slow pace, cold muted tones, vignette and fades to black. Sad or piano music.
Snappy cuts, slides and zooms, warm colors and light flares.
Fast beat-synced cuts, flashes, whip pans and glitch. Electronic or energetic music.
Trailer feel: wide shots, slow zoom, strong contrast and orchestral music.
Long dissolves, pink tones and a dreamy touch. Soft piano or guitar music.
Old film look: vintage color, grain and scratches. Lo-fi or retro music.
Wild transitions (spins, pixels, circles), vivid colors and playful music.

To get started without the hassle, try the Video assistant on the home screen: pick your photos and videos, a style and the music, and it builds a video for you with cuts on the beat, transitions, color and a title. Preview it, sort it your way and open it in the editor to tweak it. Whenever you want to see this tutorial again or read the full guide, tap the help icon (?) on the home screen.
Lower the music when a voice is heard
Detects speech in the videos (with the voice model if downloaded, otherwise by volume) and lowers the music only while it is heard.
From 5 seconds to one hour. Cuts follow the beat of the music and, if the song is shorter, it repeats. If there is not enough media, it repeats too.
Drag the three-line icon to change the order.
This is how the edit looks. If something is off, go back to change the order or settings, or try another version.
Detecting voices to lower the music…

Sharp cuts, strong contrast and zoom blur. Workout music.
Neon, flashes and glitch on the club beat. Electronic and dance music.

Vivid greens, calm shots and gentle movement. Ambient or acoustic music.
Street and city: sharp cuts, high contrast, grain and glitch. Hip-hop or lo-fi music.
Warm and familiar: golden light, soft dissolves and acoustic music.
Neon and VHS: synthetic colors, pixels and glitch. Synthwave music.

It has useful information to get the most out of Vixa: the video assistant, quick tools, effects and more. You can watch it again whenever you want from the help button (?) on the home screen or from Settings.
This project combines many effects, layers and videos at once, so playback in the editor may stutter at some points. To watch it smoothly we recommend rendering (exporting) it.
